The *Upādinnattika, Kusalattika* (Patthana 11.13) is a canonical Abhidhamma text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna* division of the Pali Tipiṭaka [SuttaCentral]. The work treats conditional relations generated by combining the triad on appropriation or attachment (*upādinnattika*) with the primary triad on wholesomeness (*kusalattika*) [SuttaCentral].
No curated or cross-language parallels in Chinese, Tibetan, or Sanskrit are recorded for this specific text [DharmaNexus]. However, automated text-reuse analysis indicates extensive formulaic overlap within the Pali *Paṭṭhāna* corpus itself, identifying 57 matching passages across 17 other texts [DharmaNexus]. The largest volumes of shared material occur with closely related combinatorial sections, notably *Vitakkattikādi, Kusalattika* (Patthana 11.15; 8 matches), *Vipākattikādi, Hetuduka* (Patthana 10.11; 9 matches), *Kusalattika, Dassanattikādi* (Patthana 11.7; 6 matches), and *Kusalattika, Pītittika* (Patthana 11.6; 3 matches) [DharmaNexus]. It likewise shares substantial recurring segments with structurally related chapters such as *Upādinnattika* (Patthana 7.4), the inverse combination *Kusalattika, Upādinnattika* (Patthana 11.3), and another treatment titled *Upādinnattika, Kusalattika* (Patthana 23.22) [DharmaNexus].
